folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B145, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
Read every original finding, generation family, R3 row and lane-return crosswalk. The later wave-1 and R3-10 returns supersede the opening universal absence of generated materials, names, people, appearance and story integration. Keep their scoped source and test identities: P34 partly closes B4; B1-B3 are not closed by that association. Stopped or cancelled duplicate WR lanes need no relaunch. A table summary does not count as a fresh read of each underlying packet.

Two old randomness findings now differ. Current `enemies.js` guardian on-hit defaults to `gameRandom(STREAMS.combat, "on_hit")`, qualifying R3-2's absence. The three inspected `crafting_recipes.js` quality methods still call imported `random_range(min,max)` without an injected source; `misc.js` defaults that function to `Math.random`. This preserves R3-1 as a selected-source finding, not a new whole-native-loop census or reproduced gameplay defect. Counts of 60/28/27 and old ratchet ceilings remain dated, and changing the seed/draw behavior needs its actual consumer contract (AD36, AR6).

CG/GL/GS/GO/GI/GA remain palettes. Lens observation and interventions have different transactions; exact observation can disclose permitted truth, while pin/reroll changes follow their actual mechanism. Hidden causes are committed before observation where already consequential; a reveal is not permission to rewrite them. Summarizing many routine outcomes need not discard durable history or cap actual earned results. No universal new registry, all-generator replay platform or unselected appearance/fate-ledger wave is imposed (AD32, AD51, AD52).

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B145, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
All PG/GN dispositions, prior corrections, site focus and later S1-S3 gap notes were reviewed. Keep F1-F4: extend real funded request owners, preserve prior hidden causes, distinguish renewable source nodes from finite shipments/owned stock, and recognize that abstract generated graphs are still generated layouts. Palette ranking is not current queue authority; the chosen Klein/Harry mechanisms and applicable AD33/SR4 deferrals retain their actual scopes.

The early AXR1/second-consumer-only extraction wording is qualified by AD51: known cross-world needs justify a shared seam with the first consumer, then a materially different consumer validates or revises it. This does not demand one universal source-node, currency, naming or projection store when existing authoritative owners and adapters fit. Three chance categories do not require three draws; a deterministic title or document can follow actual facts. A report of free production or profitable repetition is not itself a bug where supported means allow it (AD5, AD22, AD38).

GN tools remain conditional on a real selected question. A safe developer inspector does not expose sealed truth to the director, data-only packs still need admission and references, branch creation differs from undo, and a recap reports actual settled work rather than inventing away accrual. The old gen_kit Proposal header is still present in the selected source read, but this documentation task changes no code. Historical S1-S3 worktree state, poison prevention versus shortening, prepared venom, separate HP product carrier, transformation receiver, knowledge leak and literal Import gaps require their actual later owners before being called open or fixed today. Neither old 1366 testing nor mandatory human acceptance is a current extra gate (AD32, AD36, AD42).

folds.heading: ## Procedural quality and bleed findings B145, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
Scoped source reconciliation of the fully reviewed [procedural map](PROCEDURAL_GENERATION_STATUS_2026-10-13.md), R3-1/R3-2. Current `crafting_recipes.js` imports `random_range` from `misc.js`; the inspected component, componentless equipment and equipment `roll_quality` methods call it without an injected random source. `misc.js` still defaults that argument to `Math.random`. This is a surviving source-level determinism gap for those calls, not a reproduced reload exploit or proof that every crafting path is unseeded.

The guardian on-hit method now defaults to the combat stream through `gameRandom(STREAMS.combat, "on_hit")`; its old unseeded-source finding is superseded at that named consumer. No whole-game random count, source change, test or browser journey was performed. A future selected fix needs the existing stream owner, intended draw order and new-state/save policy; it should preserve documented seeded inputs rather than silently installing another root or universal anti-farming rule (AD22, AD32, AD36, AR6).
